steps.domain_action: The apparatus exists in a state of pre-reflective potentiality
The system initiates a measurement morphism toward the external field
The measurement function is composed with the internal state of the observer
The system bifurcates into the observed complement and the self-referential point
The complement is mapped with informational completeness
The system attempts to map the self-referential fixed point to itself
The diagonal construction forces a parity flip on the self-referential value
The resulting contradiction is held as the dialetheic glut B
The bivalent distinction fails at the locus of the diagonal
The complete field and the blind spot are synthesized into a single topology
The resulting state is recorded as the honest form of self-knowledge
The system reaches the terminal boundary of the Lawvere condition
